title: 加拿大贸易部长：中国市场机遇多，合作潜力巨大
speaker: Maninder Sidhu

segments.en: he spoke exclusively with, has an omen in Manila. China is a very important market to Canada, as you know, with the second largest market in the world.
segments.zh: 他独家采访了，马尼拉有预兆。中国对加拿大来说是非常重要的市场，如你所知，是世界第二大市场。

segments.en: But it's also our second largest trading partner. And I was just there a week ago meeting with Minister Wang, my counterpart, to negotiate our preliminary joint
segments.zh: 但它也是我们的第二大贸易伙伴。我一周前刚在那里与我的同行王部长会面，谈判我们的初步联合

segments.en: arrangement, have an extension of that. And so we've now secured that.
segments.zh: 安排，延长该安排。所以我们现在已经确保了这一点。

segments.en: So two more years for billions of dollars of agriculture to flow.
segments.zh: 因此，又有两年时间让数十亿美元的农产品流通。

segments.en: As you mentioned, Canola, beef, seafood, and others.
segments.zh: 正如你提到的，油菜籽、牛肉、海鲜等。

segments.en: But what we've done is I've laid some track for the prime ministers and leaders to announce more.
segments.zh: 但我们所做的是，我已经为总理和领导人铺设了一些轨道，以便宣布更多消息。

segments.en: To announce more in terms of financial services, banking, investments.
segments.zh: 在金融服务、银行业、**方面宣布更多消息。

segments.en: I mean, if you look at what China has in terms of battery storage technology, it's second to none.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，如果你看看中国在电池存储技术方面的成就，那是首屈一指的。

segments.en: And so we can use some of those capabilities in Canada, as you know, we're powering up a renewable energy sector.
segments.zh: 因此，我们可以在加拿大利用其中一些能力，如你所知，我们正在推动可再生能源行业的发展。

segments.en: And so there's partnerships to be found there. But it's also, what can we do with consumers?
segments.zh: 因此，那里有合作伙伴关系可以建立。但还有，我们能与消费者做些什么？

segments.en: China has a large consumer base. And so talking to Alibaba, see how can we get more SMEs on their website to be able to sell more through our SMEs
segments.zh: 中国有庞大的消费群体。所以与阿里巴巴交流，探讨如何让更多中小企业入驻其平台，通过我们的中小企业向中国销售更多产品。

segments.en: into China. That's a big part of that conversation. In fact, we were the guest of honor at the largest trade show in Shanghai, the CII.
segments.zh: 这是对话的重要部分。事实上，我们是上海最大贸易展会CII的主宾。

segments.en: And so that, I took over 100 Canadian companies there with me.
segments.zh: 因此，我带了100多家加拿大公司去那里。

segments.en: And so that presents a lot of opportunity. And so yes, it's commodities, consumer goods, banking, financial services, investments.
segments.zh: 这带来了很多机会。是的，包括大宗商品、消费品、银行业、金融服务、权益资产。

segments.en: And so we are unlocking more and more opportunities. And I know leaders will have more to say in a few days from now.
segments.zh: 我们正在释放越来越多的机会。我知道领导人几天后会有更多要说的。
